create_learnable_fake_quantize: create a _LearnableFakeQuantize module with learnable scale and zero point parameters for quantization
enable_param_learning: enable backpropagation-based learning of quantization scale and zero point parameters
enable_static_estimate: enable static observer estimation for quantization parameters without learning
enable_static_observation: enable data accumulation through the observer without updating quantization parameters
calculate_qparams: calculate quantization scale and zero point parameters with gradient clipping and range enforcement
